content: In addition to participating in the Sentence Level Classification task we also participate in the Fragment Level Classification task. We note that extracting fragments that are propagandistic is similar to the task of Named Entity Recognition, in that they are both span extraction tasks, and so use a BERT based model designed for this task - We build on the work by BIBREF18 which makes use of Continuous Random Field stacked on top of an LSTM to predict spans. This architecture is standard amongst state of the art models that perform span identification.
